meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section. Transforms your writing process from solo effort to collaborative partnership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过调研、引用和实时反馈提升写作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效完成高质量文章或内容创作
copy.tagline_en: Improve writing quality with research, citations, and real-time feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce high-quality articles or content efficiently

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会像写作伙伴一样与你协作:先帮你列大纲、理清结构;你边写它边逐节反馈;需要时它会查资料、补引用、改开头钩子,最后整体润色,并尽量保持你的语言风格。
howto.when: 当你请求写作帮助时触发,例如写博客文章、改进开头或获取分节反馈等。

say.text: 帮我把『AI 对产品管理的影响』列成博客大纲
say.note: Claude 会先问几个澄清问题再给结构

say.text: 这是我写的开头,给我三个更抓人的钩子版本
say.note: 它会分析现有开头并给替代方案

say.text: 我刚写完『常见误区』一节,帮我点评一下
say.note: 它会按清晰度、论据、流畅度逐条反馈

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a writing partner: it helps you outline, gives feedback on each section as you write, researches and adds citations, improves hooks, and polishes the final draft while keeping your voice.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for writing help, e.g. drafting a blog post, improving an opening hook, or getting section feedback.

say_en.text: Help me turn 'AI's impact on product management' into a blog outline.
say_en.note: Claude asks a few clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Here's my opening. Give me three stronger hook versions.
say_en.note: It analyzes the current hook and offers alternatives.

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Common Mistakes' section. Review it.
say_en.note: It gives line-by-line feedback on clarity, evidence, flow.
